messages.subject: Issue with reading .gt3x
parts:
Hopefully this is just a setup issue.

I'm using GGIR version 3.0.9 and read.gt3x version 1.2.0. When I run the code, in part 1, I get several of the following errors:

Errors and warnings for meta_2.gt3x.RData$message
[1] "\nError processing meta_2.gt3x.RData: unrecognised file format.\n"

Am I missing a package?

Thanks for any help you might be able to provide.

-Peter

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Issue with reading .gt3x
parts:
Could it be that you have GGIR output files in your input folder (specified with datadir)?
GGIR does not like that because then it tries to process those files as accelerometer files.

Vincent
